Just a reminder,

AI-specific pre-production checks for prod deployment

You need to check:

Functional
Does request work?
Does retrieval work?
Does tool calling work?
Does structured output work?

Quality
Is answer grounded?
Is hallucination rate acceptable?
Is retrieval quality acceptable?
Is response relevant?

Performance
P50 latency
P95 latency
P99 latency

TTFT
tokens/sec
request throughput[e2e requency latency]
TPOT
tokens per second
requests per second

Cost
input tokens
output tokens
cost/request
cost/user
cost/day


Safety: Usually covered with guardrails, Observability as well as Verification Layer.

prompt injection
sensitive data leakage
unsafe output
tool abuse
excessive permissions
Reliability
timeouts
retries
rate limits
provider failures
fallback model
circuit breaker
